info.title: DataFrame Splitter Service
info.description: A service to split a Pandas DataFrame into training and testing parts.

post.summary: Split DataFrame into train and test sets
post.description: This endpoint accepts a Pandas DataFrame as input and splits it into training and testing parts based on the specified test size.

dataframe.description: The input DataFrame represented as a JSON object, where keys are column names and values are arrays of column data.

test_size.description: Proportion of the dataset to include in the test split (value between 0 and 1).

random_state.description: Seed for the random number generator for reproducibility.

200.description: Successful operation. Returns the training and testing splits of the input DataFrame.

train.description: Training portion of the split DataFrame.

test.description: Testing portion of the split DataFrame.
